FLOWERS ARE our FASHION

and WEDDINGS ARE THE RUNWAY

PROUDLY IN BUSINESS for 45 YEARS

from OUR FIELDS

INTO your HANDS.

We use data driven forecasting to produce the right flower at the right time. We are RED and PINK for February, spring is COLORFUL for March & April, May is for Mothers who love ALL COLORS from their kids, June is WHITE with weddings, and doesn’t stop until October.

Look to FALLING LEAF COLORS to takes us to December and RED AGAIN with Holly. We work with farms on cut point for event work to minimize processing. We pride ourselves on strict quality control and correct fulfillment. We guarantee quality of bulk flower shipments by inspecting each box prior to shipment. We bring in flowers from all over the world and love that we have customers who ask us to find what they need, as well as produce some of the finest ROSES in the world.

DISTRIBUTING & SOURCING flowers ALL OVER THE WORLD

We use data driven forecasting to introduce and follow fashion trends, especially during May through October which is heavy wedding season. We work with farms on cut point for event work to minimize handling. When an order is placed online, a confirmation will be sent within 3 days. We have experienced sales associates who communicate with the client to make sure they are informed of the flowers being used and what is available for that season. We pride ourselves on strict quality control and correct fulfillment. We guarantee quality of bulk flower shipments by inspecting each box prior to shipment.
